findings.text: imas_codex/standard_names/attachment_audit.py:234 adds a second {live_child} placeholder to the shared _ATTACHMENTS_QUERY template, so the existing calls mod._ATTACHMENTS_QUERY.format(scope=...) at tests/standard_names/test_attachment_audit.py:690, 707, 1017 and 1018 now raise KeyError: 'live_child' — breaking every graph-marked test that uses _scoped/_ScopedClient in a file the node's own gate enumerates. Verified by import: mod._ATTACHMENTS_QUERY.format(scope='') raises KeyError 'live_child'. The gate's default marker set deselected those tests (31 deselected in gate-head), so the regression was not measured; reproduce with 'uv run pytest tests/standard_names/test_attachment_audit.py -m graph'. Repairable inside the node's scope by not putting the live-child clause behind a .format placeholder in the shared constant.

imas_codex/standard_names/attachment_audit.py:2969 _names_stranded_by_detach re-expresses the invariant's own 'live, sourceless' predicate in Python (non-stale-producer test at lines 2969-2971, superseded/derived-parent exemption at lines 1076-1084) rather than calling find_sourceless_live_names or its Cypher, which the node brief required ('Use the invariant's own predicate or its Cypher; write no second definition of a live, sourceless name'). It composes _live_child_cypher() from imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py but duplicates the non-stale and superseded clauses, so the hold and the backstop can drift; the audit read also requires FROM_DD_PATH, so a producer without that edge is invisible to the hold and it over-holds relative to the invariant.
